reference_policy: unchanged independently propagated original-input global reference
arithmetic: Unchanged native S16 RTZ; signed int64 Q24 I/Z residuals and RNE16 views. Official G128 asymmetric packed INT4, native GEMM nibble order, no qzero plus-one, FP16 scales/operator boundaries/KV. Q24 state is wider than FP16, not strict-FP16-state W4A16.
authentication: Reuse the accepted L21 margin checker and its read-only reconstruction of the L15 cut, L16-L20 accepted frozen states and first L21/P0/S18 failure. Authenticate pinned result/command/validation, repository source origins, complete original-input global-reference recurrence, local references, retained S16 operands, paired I/Z/H, exact S12/S18 transitions and layer-owned empty-P0/FP16 KV. Preserve the L21 coordinate-62 excess of 3/4 against the unchanged 1/8 budget. Recheck bound bytes before returning.
local_predicate: finite AND (absolute_error <= 1/8 OR (relative_error < 1/1000 AND ordered_FP16_ULP <= 1)); denominator=max(abs(reference),2^-14)
reproduction: The command compiles the actual repository diagnostic and test sources in memory, parses and checks this JSON contract, collects and runs exactly 24 focused tests once with zero failures/errors/skips, then authenticates frozen evidence once. --check stops at this preflight with zero native dispatch. --execute then reproduces retained L21 bitwise and runs the fixed nested canonical controls, checking each mandatory gate before its consumer. It records origins, digests, full gate reports, operand cuts, coordinate-62 exact residual contributions and phase timings in stdout JSON. It creates no files. Every imported candidate and tests.test_q24_s16_toward_zero_l3_l8_v1 must resolve inside this repository. The legacy module is imported only for origin binding; its accepted 19 tests and all upstream suites are never run. Host owns independent Reviewer reproduction.

executor.parent: authenticated frozen L20 output I/Z/H; never the adjusted L21 output
executor.S16: independent same-operand binary64 SiLU/product with unchanged FP16 RTZ
executor.stop: first new mandatory gate failure or full-vector S18 pass; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
executor.output: stdout only; no state archive, successor or admission

control_semantics: Ordered nested whole-vector same-input canonical suffixes, starting at S17 and widening through S16, up, gate, post-attention norm, O, AV, V-cache, V projection and input norm. S12/S18 retain exact native Q24 additions verified independently; neither residual state nor original global reference is substituted. P0 Q/K remain native, gated and KV-authenticated; unit probability makes them irrelevant to the current value cone. S16 canonical controls independently compute binary64 SiLU/product but preserve FP16 RTZ, not the local reference's RNE. The unchanged local RNE oracle remains the gate. Baseline S18 coordinate-62 failure is the control target, not a stopping reason for the entire sweep. A new local failure, any other global failing coordinate or full-vector S18 pass stops the sweep immediately. Exhaustion yields explicit INCONCLUSIVE, never scientific PASS or unique producer attribution.
reviewer_rejection_criteria: Reject any candidate/test source-origin mismatch, test count other than 24, skipped or failed test, retained baseline byte/report mismatch, unauthenticated L20 parent/source/operand/KV/reference, changed numerical gate/reference/S16 precision, unregistered cut, continued execution after a decisive control, native layer other than L21, more than 11 native invocations, nonzero native L0-L8 or RTL invocation, state publication or admission claim.
claim_boundary: The top-level zero native counters describe --check only. --execute reports measured L21 dispatch counts separately and permits no other native layer. Frozen inputs remain read-only and no --out, state archive or successor is exposed. A controlled pass boundary is non-admitting evidence, not root-cause, strict-FP16-state W4A16, new-token, full-model, hardware or campaign-final PASS. All historical failures and bounded independent acceptances remain unchanged.
